name: Three Kingdoms: Shu-Han Chronicles
detailed_description:
"Three Kingdoms: Shu-Han Chronicles" is a retro-style turn-based RPG that follows Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei's journey from their Peach Garden Oath to restoring order during the Eastern Han Dynasty's turmoil.

■ Turn-Based System & Unique Features

Over 200 Three Kingdoms generals appear

Recruit 50+ legendary commanders through story progression and battles

Unique skills per commander: Damage/Healing/Support/Crowd Control

Commanders can handle civil affairs, boost income via commerce policies, obtain rare treasures through exploration, and assist in military campaigns

■ Attributes

Troop Count: HP. Higher troop count increases damage output. Note: Damage decreases when troops dwindle - replenish promptly.

Strategy Points: SP for skill usage. Cannot heal troops when depleted.

Might: Affects normal attacks/counterattacks/blade damage. Higher Might than opponent deals bonus damage.

Intellect: Boosts healing and tactical damage. Higher Intellect than opponent increases damage.

Speed: Determines turn order (fastest acts first, except priority skills)

Attack: Enhances physical damage types. Improved via gear/skills.

Tactics: Enhances healing and tactical damage. Improved via gear/skills.

Defense: Reduces incoming damage. Improved via gear/skills.

Critical Rate: At 100%, deals 150% critical damage.

■ Equipment System

Weapons: Primary ATK/Tactics boost

Helms: Main DEF source

Armor: Main DEF source

Mounts: Speed boost (special mounts have bonus effects)

Tomes: Equip to unlock unique skills

short_description: A traditional turn-based role-playing game depicting the story of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the unification of China. Featuring over 200 characters, players can recruit enemy generals (beyond the Shu Han faction) to build unique battle formations.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
